title: Revisiting Subgradient Dominance in Robust MDPs: Counterexamples, Hardness, and Sufficient Conditions
summary: Projected subgradient descent (PSD) has gained popularity for solving robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) because it applies to a broader class of uncertainty sets than traditional dynamic programming. Existing work claims that RMDPs with a general compact uncertainty set satisfy the subgradient dominance property, under which exact PSD finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy in a polynomial number of updates (e.g., Wang et al., 2023).
